WITH invoice_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(i.invoice_number) as invoice_count
  FROM Orders o
  LEFT JOIN Invoices i ON o.order_id = i.order_id
  GROUP BY o.order_id
),
total_count AS (
  SELECT SUM(invoice_count) as total_invoices
  FROM invoice_counts
),
order_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    ic.invoice_count,
    CAST(ic.invoice_count AS DECIMAL(19,4)) / 
    CAST((SELECT total_invoices FROM total_count) AS DECIMAL(19,4)) as share
  FROM invoice_counts ic
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share_value
  FROM order_shares
)
SELECT 
  SUM(os.invoice_count) as total_invoices,
  AVG(os.share) as average_share,
  AVG(os.share - (SELECT avg_share_value FROM avg_share)) as average_excess
FROM order_shares os
WHERE os.share > (SELECT avg_share_value FROM avg_share)
